scope: candidate ConPTY resize replay identity, bounded history, Find and selection; not R2 completion
source_identity_note: Hashes identify raw worktree bytes and local binaries, not an independent source-to-binary proof

replay_fixture.provenance: Synthetic TF_FIND lines captured from the original owned non-input-desktop failure; no private session or WindTerm resource

baseline.symptom: real ConPTY replay preserved the target text but changed its row identity and invalidated Find and the whole-document selection

observed_causes.identity_collision: The original FFI IDs were unique, but replay remapping could collide with another raw row. One snapshot had duplicate IDs across history and visible rows and 197697 retained search metadata rows for an 82-row document.
observed_causes.history_overwrite: Growing the viewport first pulled old history into visible rows. The subsequent ConPTY repaint overwrote TF_FIND_072 through TF_FIND_074 with later rows; resize alone did not remove them.
observed_causes.text_projection: Concatenating cells exposed a wide-character zero-width spacer as an extra blank. The existing project_line contract produced the expected 29-byte target instead of the 31-byte raw-cell string; assertions now use that projection without dropping explicit styled tail spaces.
observed_causes.selection_endpoint: Select All used an excluded zero-column empty endpoint. Only an endpoint that remains empty may acquire a replacement identity; nonempty endpoints and actual text changes still invalidate atomically.

implemented_contract.bounded_replay: Split cursor hide/show markers are recognized only after resize. Pending snapshots are bounded by 8192 bytes and released on overflow or finish.
implemented_contract.identity: Only rows whose complete keys are unique and ordered retain ID/version. Final retained IDs are nonzero, unique and strictly increasing; conflicts receive fresh identity/version. Raw FFI IDs and retained identities are tracked separately.
implemented_contract.history: After a complete replay, prior bounded history is merged by ID and full row key. Actual evictions are not resurrected, and explicit clear does not restore old rows. Empty rows are not blindly matched.
implemented_contract.continuous_sync: An FFI-ID to retained-ID alias cache avoids a full history key scan on every feed; an unknown old ID can still require full replay matching.
implemented_contract.search: Find live-validates ID, version, position and projected text. Non-soft physical width or successor-ID changes alone do not invalidate a hit, but adding the first successor introduces an LF and requires a rescan. Metadata remains bounded by the retained document.
implemented_contract.default_core: The original physical-row clipping and resize-version semantics remain unchanged.

coverage: whole and bytewise replay with identical target ID, position and projected text
ordered unique retained identities and duplicate-text negative cases
live Find after change notification with bounded metadata
line and whole-document selection bytes including the excluded empty endpoint
persistent identities across subsequent empty synchronization
incomplete replay bound, finish release and explicit history clear
